sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Construct used in transgenic mice to track Lypd6 expression; surface localisation implied by use in vivo but no explicit functional assay result is reported in the ledger clip.
sites.rationale: LYPD6 is a GPI-anchored protein with signal peptide residues 1–22 and an entirely extracellular mature domain (residues 23–171); the C-terminal hydrophobic stretch (CLWLWLGLML, ~residues 162–171) is the GPI-anchor signal that is cleaved during GPI attachment, making the C-terminus inaccessible for a surface tag. Therefore the mature N-terminus (after SP cleavage at residue 22/23) is the sole extracellular terminus available. Python confirmed position 22 = A and position 23 = A; insert_after_residue = 22 places the HA tag between the last SP residue and the first mature residue, so after SP cleavage the tag is the new extracellular N-terminus. The position is topology_derived because the ledger clip names no residue number. Full-length Lypd6 HA-tagged construct expressed in transgenic mice (PMC2716416). The ledger header states the HA tag is at the amino-terminus of Lypd6; the quote states 'The Lypd6 ORF was fused to the amino-terminus of the HA epitope (YPYDVPDYA).' No residue number is named.

sources.claim: The Lypd6 ORF was fused to the amino-terminus of the HA epitope (YPYDVPDYA).

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) is provided. It describes a full-length, membrane-anchored Lypd6 construct with an HA tag at the protein's amino-terminus used in transgenic mice, which qualifies under the rules. The quote wording ('Lypd6 ORF was fused to the amino-terminus of the HA epitope') is ambiguous but the ledger header resolves it as an N-terminal HA tag on Lypd6; a C-terminal tag would be cleaved with the GPI anchor signal and would not yield a surface-detectable tag, making the N-terminal interpretation the only biologically coherent one. No residue number is stated, so the position is topology_derived from the single extracellular terminus. Confidence is medium rather than high because the quote wording is internally ambiguous and the ledger clip does not report an explicit surface-detection or functional assay result.
